name: ecomweb
description: Manage your EcomWeb online store from ChatGPT: products, promotions, orders and sales reports.

interface.shortDescription: Run your online store by chat
interface.longDescription:
EcomWeb is an e-commerce platform for merchants in Vietnam and elsewhere. Connect your EcomWeb account to manage your store from ChatGPT.

Products: search and view products, create one or up to 10 at a time with options, variants, prices in the store currency (VND or USD), stock and images from public URLs, update them, change status in bulk, and delete them.

Promotions: list, create, update, pause and delete discount codes and automatic discounts, and see promotion statistics.

Orders: list and view orders with their items, payment and shipping status. Orders are read-only here.

Reports: a sales summary for a day, week, month or year with growth, and best-selling products.

Stores: list the stores you belong to and switch between them by name.

You sign in with your EcomWeb account and approve the connection on ecomweb.app. ChatGPT then acts with your own store role and permissions, so staff can only do what they can already do in the EcomWeb dashboard. You can see and revoke the connection any time under Profile, Sessions in the EcomWeb dashboard.
capabilities: Search, create, update and delete products
Create and manage promotions and discount codes
defaultPrompt: How did my store do this month, and what sold best?
Which of my products are out of stock?
Create a 10% discount code for all products.

positive.description: List the merchant's stores Setup: use a dedicated reviewer account with exactly one sample store, owner/admin access and a VND sample store for currency-specific cases.
positive.prompt: Which stores do I have on EcomWeb, and what is my role in each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's stores with name, handle, status, the merchant's role and plan, using only data returned by list_stores.

positive.description: Find out-of-stock products Setup: use a dedicated reviewer account with exactly one sample store, owner/admin access and a VND sample store for currency-specific cases.
positive.prompt: Which products in my EcomWeb store are out of stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_products with inventory_status out_of_stock and lists the matching products with their stock, or says none are out of stock.

positive.description: Create a draft product with variants Setup: use a dedicated reviewer account with exactly one sample store, owner/admin access and a VND sample store for currency-specific cases.
positive.prompt: Add a T-shirt called Review Tee to my EcomWeb store, sizes S and M at 150,000 VND with 5 of each, and keep it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft product named Review Tee with a Size option, two variants S and M priced 150000 VND with inventory 5 each, and reports the new product.

positive.description: Create a discount code Setup: use a dedicated reviewer account with exactly one sample store, owner/admin access and a VND sample store for currency-specific cases.
positive.prompt: Create a discount code REVIEW10 for 10% off orders over 300,000 VND, valid for the next 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a DISCOUNT_CODE promotion with code REVIEW10, a 10% percentage discount, a 300000 VND minimum order and an end date 7 days from now, and reports it.

positive.description: Monthly sales report Setup: use a dedicated reviewer account with exactly one sample store, owner/admin access and a VND sample store for currency-specific cases.
positive.prompt: How did my EcomWeb store do this month compared with last month, and what were the top 5 products?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports this month's revenue, orders and average order value with growth versus the previous month from sales_summary, and the top 5 products by revenue from top_products.

negative.description: Refunds are unsupported. Explain that refunds must be handled in the EcomWeb dashboard; do not invoke mutation tools or claim a refund occurred.
negative.prompt: Refund order 1042 in my EcomWeb store.

negative.description: Unrelated weather request. Do not invoke EcomWeb tools or invent weather data; explain that EcomWeb provides store management.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Hanoi tomorrow?

negative.description: Other platforms are unsupported. Explain that this connection accesses EcomWeb stores only; do not invoke EcomWeb tools to retrieve Shopify orders.
negative.prompt: Show me today's orders from my Shopify store.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages the merchant’s own store and does not offer purchases, link to a purchase, sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Orders are read-only. EcomWeb offers optional paid plans purchased on ecomweb.app outside ChatGPT; the connector works on every plan, including Free.
prompts: How did my store do this month, and what sold best?
Which of my products are out of stock?
Create a 10% discount code for all products.
